channel.title: Felix Krusch - Insights
channel.description: First-hand notes on design, development, and building things that work.

item.title: Getting It Done
item.description: Clients need good decisions and someone who makes them work. A short note on thinking, execution, and taking responsibility through launch.

item.title: 100 on desktop. 100 on mobile.
item.description: The felixkrusch.com redesign scored 100 in all four PageSpeed Insights categories on desktop and mobile. Why the technical foundation matters to me.

item.title: How Long Does It Take to Get a Website Designed?
item.description: A business website typically takes 1-3 weeks once scope and content are ready. See the stages, approval points, and what can delay launch.

item.title: What Questions Should You Ask Before Hiring a Web Designer?
item.description: Ask about the platform, ownership, scope, timeline, and support before hiring a web designer. Practical questions, good answers, and warning signs.

item.title: How Much Does It Cost to Hire a Web Designer?
item.description: What changes a website quote? Compare freelancer and agency costs, see my starting prices, and understand design, CMS, revisions, and hosting.

item.title: Should I Hire a Web Designer or Use a DIY Website Builder?
item.description: Compare a DIY website builder with professional web design: costs, your time, editing, maintenance, and when each approach makes sense.

item.title: Agility and Pivots
item.description: I never planned to specialize. I just got really good at one thing because that was how I lived. Over time it became my sharp spike.

item.title: Agents Are the New CMS
item.description: An idea for managing websites through AI agents: request changes in plain language, review a preview, and keep a traceable publishing workflow.

item.title: WordPress FSE diminishing returns
item.description: WordPress FSE is a lesson in diminishing returns. The complexity-to-flexibility ratio doesn't make sense when modern stacks just work.

item.title: Why 85% of Cleaning Companies & Janitor Websites Scare Off Customers in 2026
item.description: A practical look at cleaning company websites: loading speed, service details, contact forms, real photographs, reviews, and mobile usability.

item.title: Freelancers Obliterate Agencies for SMEs in 2026 - Wake Up
item.description: My case for working directly with a freelancer: fewer handoffs, clear responsibility, and project costs. An opinion from independent practice.

item.title: Noise drowns signal, people tune out
item.description: Why genuine personal experience matters when platforms are flooded with content, and how filtering changes what people notice and trust.

item.title: You don't need a CMS anymore
item.description: My argument for simpler publishing without a traditional CMS: less platform maintenance, lightweight pages, and a workflow shaped around the content.
